newsitem.title: FRANCE: Salomon H1 sales rise sharply.
newsitem.headline: Salomon H1 sales rise sharply.

text.p: (All figures in millions of French francs)
NOTE - Sports equipment manufacturer Salomon issued the
sales results for the first half of its 1996/97 year in a

It said sales were up 20.2 percent over the year-earlier period, helped by a 68 percent rise in hiking equipment and a 77 percent sales rise in the Taylor Made brand. Mavic brand sales rose 4.1 percent, but sales of winter sports equipment fell 16 percent.
At constant currency rates, first-half sales were up 21.8 percent, it said.
It said Mavic brand sales should grow faster in the second half, and Taylor Made brand sales should show a full-year increase of around 50 percent.
Salomon said it expected to strike a balance between sales of summer and winter sports equipment by the end of the 1996/97 year.
